messages:
maria: Quick sync — enterprise customer wants Dedicated + Private availability in the same quarter. Need cross-team sequencing + a minimal launch checklist. Who has immediate blockers?
jonathan: Infra: main blocker is GPU pool lead time (6–8w). Short-term we can carve burst capacity from hosted, but that needs accounting sign-off.
kevin: Runtime: perf looks OK on current quantized build but we need a canary to validate cold-start KV cache behavior. Also tls cert rotation in private deploys needs automation.
tara: Security: SOC2 scoping is done but infra hardening and HSM integration for Private will take ~3 sprints. We can shadow audit on Dedicated first.
ankush: Product: customers require SLA + migration path. We should define launch pillars: cost/capacity SLAs, privacy controls, and predictable latency.
maria: Proposal: 1) Canaries on hosted (runtime team) 2) Reserve burst Dedicated nodes (infra) 3) Parallel security hardening on Private but gated — don't block Dedicated GA. Thoughts?
kevin: 👍 on parallel work. For canary I need an e2e test harness and a small prompt corpus from PMs. Can we get that today?
ankush: I'll drop a short prompt set in the thread by EOD. Also adding a customer success checklist for migration docs.
jonathan: Action item: I'll ask finance for short-term burst budget and start procurement ticket for long-term reserved pool. ETA on budget reply: 2 business days.
tara: Security action: I'll schedule an intake with infra to list HSM/KMS gaps. Assigning a 2-week spike to prototype rotation scripts.
maria: Can we put a minimal launch gating list here? If any gate fails, we soft-launch Dedicated with degraded features and hold Private.
kevin: Here's a minimal gating checklist:
```
- Perf: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms for target prompts
- Stability: 48h canary with <0.5% error rate
- Infra: Burst capacity verified, autoscale sanity tests pass
- Security: HSM/KMS PoC for key rotation OR documented compensating control
- Docs: migration + rollback runbook published
```
maria: Perfect. I'll collate and turn into a launch ticket. Who can volunteer to own the Dedicated GA runbook?
jonathan: I'll own the infra runbook.
tara: I'll own the security checklist and postmortem template.
ankush: Product runbook and customer comms — I'll do it.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: hosted-canary-1855 at 2026-07-12T15:00Z (owner: kevin).
maria: Great — next sync Friday 10am PT. Please update this thread with blockers before then. :thumbsup:
kevin: Adding canary dashboard link and short test harness in a follow-up message.
ankush: Added prompt set (shared link) and initial migration FAQ draft.
jonathan: Procurement ticket created: INF-2981. Link in thread.
tara: Intake scheduled with infra for HSM gap analysis for Monday.
maria: Awesome — keeping this tight. If anything changes ping me directly. Thanks all.
